item.title: Pagination Seed 01: A quiet morning
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Morning light reaches the empty desk. This short entry marks the first stop in a local pagination journey.

item.title: Pagination Seed 02: Notes on paper
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: A paper notebook keeps a small record of ideas. Its pages make room for sketches before any code is written.

item.title: Pagination Seed 03: A useful pause
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Stepping away from a problem can reveal a simpler path. A brief pause is sometimes the most useful tool.

item.title: Pagination Seed 04: Small steps
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Small steps make a long project easier to inspect. Each change has a purpose and a clear stopping point.

item.title: Pagination Seed 05: Clear signals
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: A clear signal helps readers find their way through a list. Navigation should explain where it leads.

item.title: Pagination Seed 06: The second page
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: A second page only appears when the first is full. This entry helps test that transition with real posts.

item.title: Pagination Seed 07: Familiar paths
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Familiar paths are easy to follow in both directions. A previous link should return to the first list.

item.title: Pagination Seed 08: Room to read
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Good spacing gives every title room to breathe. A compact list can still make its stories easy to scan.

item.title: Pagination Seed 09: Check the boundary
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Boundary checks keep an index honest. The same article should not appear on both sides of a page turn.

item.title: Pagination Seed 10: Back to the start
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Every journey through an archive can return to its beginning. The final seed post closes this small set.
